# `aitbc bond challenge`

Fetch the wallet-ownership challenge for a provider bond (#1967). Prints the nonce and canonical message to sign with the provider's registered wallet; pass the resulting signature via --wallet on ``bond create``/``bond top-up`` (or sign manually and post challenge_nonce/wallet_signature to the API).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bond challenge [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider-id` | text | — | yes | Provider ID. |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bond challenge --provider-id <provider_id>
```
